milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray concrete powder pillar is centered at spawn-relative (4, 1, 1). Max distance reduced to 5 blocks to ensure the player has actually navigated toward the structure rather than triggering from spawn (spawn-to-target distance is ~4.2 blocks, so the player must walk at least a couple blocks forward and face it). Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking at the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lime concrete pillar is centered at spawn-relative (7, 1, 1). Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player must navigate past the first waypoint and approach the lime concrete structure. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking at the bright green blocks.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished blackstone brick stairs with a pickaxe drops the item into the player's inventory. The player has a wooden pickaxe (sufficient for this block type) and needs to mine at least 1 stair block. Without a pickaxe the block would drop nothing, so this rule also implicitly verifies correct tool usage.
